definition.description:
Calibrate the light path of every active detector: its pixel-to-stage transform.

The stage moves in x only, then in y only, at a fixed focus, by as much as shifts the image
by `SHIFT_OF_FRAME`; the image shifts give the pixel scale (rotation and flip included),
stored per light path for the frames acquired through it. The stage ends where it started.
definition.name: Calibrate Light Path

definition.description:
Scan a rectangular region tile by tile.

The region from (start_x, start_y) to (end_x, end_y) (micrometres of `system`) is covered
with fields of view of the detector (`detector_name`, else the first active one),
overlapping by `overlap`, visited in `scan_order`; every active detector acquires a
frame at each tile.
definition.name: Scan Region

definition.description:
Acquire the channels named, on a stack of planes, over a grid of tiles, some times.

Each channel is taken at the brightness its source has now (its preset when it is off) and the
exposure its detectors have now. The planes are centred where the focus is, and the tiles of a
grid around where the view is, a field of view apart less the overlap.
definition.name: Acquire Mda

definition.description:
Measure where the calibration's holder sits on the stage, from its calibration slide.

Homes what the calibration says (the stage's 0 is there), sets what it says (light, focus),
goes where the holder's mount puts the mark and holds: someone checks that the stage was homed
and the light falls on the calibration slide's mark, and approves. Then it looks for the mark
around there, brings it into the middle of the image and takes the mount from where the stage
is. The mount is used from then on, and kept in the calibration store.
definition.name: Calibrate Mount
